left_out.rule: A model whose responses the parser reads in under 90 percent of the choice items that it received (the choice sets with and without brand names, the repeated sets and the direct premium's sets), not counting the responses that decline to recommend any product, which are an outcome (common/decline.py), is reported apart, with its own estimates, and left out of every estimate over models (the open-models rule, models/open_models_plan.md, which the pretest also applied).
